name: page-source-cursor
title: Page Source Cursor
description: A PageSource adapter for cursor paging: opaque cursors from the server (`nextCursor`, `prevCursor`) or keyset cursors built from the rows' sort key.
docs: `cursorSource({ key, getId, request, afterParam, beforeParam, sizeParam, keyset, read })` sends `?cursor=…&limit=25` (and `before` going back) and reads `{ items, nextCursor?, prevCursor?, hasMore? }`. With `keyset: { cursor: (row) => … }` it builds the cursor from the last (or first) row and asks for one row more to know whether another page follows; the server returns a backward page in display order. The table loads more by default. Each takes `params: (filter) => …` for a serializer's output, `sortStyle` and `maxPageSize`; return `readJson(response)` from `request` so a failed status throws an `HttpError`.
